traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and detailed requirements for Story 020.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION are implemented: - Test files are detected via configurable path-substring patterns and selectively validated. - File-level @supports annotations are required in test files, with a safe, TODO-style placeholder auto-fix when missing. - describe() blocks in test files must include a story reference matching a configurable pattern (defaulting to "Story N.N-"). - it()/test() names in test files must start with a [REQ-XXX] requirement prefix; malformed but recognizable prefixes are optionally normalized, while completely missing prefixes produce a clear error without guessing IDs. - The rule follows ESLint best practices (meta, schema, messageIds, fixers), is integrated into the plugin’s recommended/strict configs as an error-level rule, is thoroughly tested (valid/invalid and auto-fix scenarios), and is documented in user-docs. - The full Jest suite, including tests explicitly tagged as supporting docs/stories/020.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION.story.md, passes. Accordingly, this story is fully implemented and verified.
